payload.title: ICMP messages
payload.summary: Parse and checksum generic ICMP messages, build exact echo messages, and transform a validated request into an atomic reply.

prerequisites: C17 arrays, pointers, size_t, fixed-width integers, and network byte order
The Internet checksum and the fact that IPv4 carries ICMP as protocol 1
outcomes: Parse bounded generic ICMP messages and verify the complete-message checksum
Build exact echo request and reply messages with preserved identifiers, sequences, and payloads
Separate common ICMP framing from strict echo-specific semantics

checks: Publish parser output only after validating the entire message and checksum
Preserve odd-length payload bytes and support an in-place echo reply
Leave failed destinations untouched and initialize every reported length or structure

allowed: Pure byte-array parsing and echo construction
Caller-owned storage with no allocation or mutable globals
excluded: Sending ping traffic, receiving operating-system errors, or using raw sockets
Packet capture, live networking, or external commands
Treating a checksum as cryptographic authentication
